summary: Iteration 3 fully verified. Backend pytest: 55/55 pass in 20.5s (all 33 iter-2 regression tests still green + 22 new tests covering freshness fields, 5 full courses × 15 modules × 12 quiz, Stripe packages, session create/status/webhook flows, auth-gating, seat clamping, cross-user 403). Frontend: catalog shows 23 cards each with freshness badge (top-right teal '82/93/97/99/etc.' pill + Radio icon) and 'REFRESHED Xd/mo ago' text. All 4 new full courses (prompt-engineering-mastery, multi-agent-systems, rag-enterprise, ai-governance-compliance) plus agentic-ai-foundations show 'FULL CURRICULUM' badge, load Course Detail with 15 modules, and expose 'FRESHNESS X · Refreshed Xd ago' in hero meta. /pricing: Practitioner shows monthly CTA + 'Save 17% — pay annual' secondary link, Professional shows 'Enroll for $499', Team has seats input (default 25, dynamic price recomputed for 50 seats × $18 = $900). Not-logged-in click → /login redirect. Logged-in click → POST /api/checkout/session returns checkout.stripe.com URL, browser redirects to it (verified session_id cs_test_a1... prefix + host = checkout.stripe.com). /pricing/success?session_id=<real> renders 'Confirming your enrollment…' polling UI; /pricing/success?session_id=<dummy> renders graceful 'Transaction not found' error. Regressions all pass: AI Tutor button at bottom-left (x=24, y=1012), Google button visible on /login, Intelligence page shows 'Q1 2026 Enterprise Agentic AI Intelligence Brief' + signal cards.

minor.issue: amount is computed as float and passed to Stripe (float multiplication e.g. 18.0*100=1800.0 could produce 18.99999... for other pkgs). Currently safe for {29, 290, 499, 18*seats} but consider Decimal or integer-cents for future price additions.

No IP allow-listing / retry idempotency by event_id — a replayed webhook with same session_id will re-set payment_status (fine since idempotent grant guarded by `txn.get('payment_status') != 'paid'`). Acceptable.

issues: Score >=90 pill uses text-brand+border-brand+bg-brand/5 which on the light `bg-background/90` behind it produces a very faint fill; still readable but the '99' teal number can look washed on light thumbnails. Consider slightly higher bg opacity (bg-background) for stronger contrast.

action_items: LOW: Consider integer-cents (or Decimal) for Stripe amount to future-proof against float rounding when new package amounts are added.
LOW: Optional — slightly bump freshness badge background opacity for cleaner contrast on light thumbnails.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~906 lines. Recommend splitting: intelligence router, checkout router, courses router into /app/backend/routers/*.py for maintainability (>700 line threshold breached).
seed_database() upserts full courses on EVERY startup which overwrites any per-user edits to modules/quiz. Fine for MVP; document this behavior or gate with an env flag SEED_ON_STARTUP=true.

_get_stripe(request) constructs the webhook_url from request.base_url — this uses the request's Host header. Behind a proxy without X-Forwarded-Proto handling the scheme may be http even when public URL is https, which will cause Stripe to reject the webhook_url. Currently works because Emergent ingress terminates TLS and sets forwarded headers; document this assumption.

PAYMENT_PACKAGES amounts hard-coded server-side (good — prevents client tampering). However there's no unit test asserting frontend Pricing.jsx labels match backend amounts. If they drift users see $29 client-side but pay a different amount server-side. Add a snapshot test.
Frontend Pricing.jsx handleCheckout swallows the response object but does not surface a specific error when window.location.href assignment silently fails; extremely edge-case.
test_credentials: Fresh users registered per pytest session and per browser test (test.learner+<ts>@, test.checkout+<ts>@, test.polling+<ts>@ / TestPass123!).
seed_data_creation: None — used pre-seeded 23 courses + intelligence cache. Registered 3-4 ephemeral users during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 iteration-3 features working end-to-end. Backend has 55 tests (added TestFreshness [3], TestFullCourses [6 parametrized + 1 aggregate], TestStripeCheckout [13]). Test order-safe (uses per-fixture users). Stripe: sk_test_emergent test key returns real checkout.stripe.com URLs — never complete the payment in-browser. payment_transactions collection stores {session_id, user_id, package_id, tier, amount, payment_status='initiated'|'paid', status='pending'|'complete', metadata}. Frontend testId prefixes: catalog uses 'catalog-course-card-<slug>', course cards emit 'freshness-badge-<slug>', Pricing uses 'plan-<name>-cta' + 'plan-practitioner-annual-cta' + 'team-seats-input'. CheckoutSuccess emits 'checkout-polling'|'checkout-success'|'checkout-error'|'checkout-expired'|'checkout-timeout'.
